description: Presidential Secretariat - Notifying that the Duties & Functions of the Ministers published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1933/13 of 21.09.2015 be ameded by insertion into the Heading "Minister of Ports & Shipping (No. 33)"
reasoning: This gazette content names a specific individual (President Maithripala Sirisena) and details the amendment of his powers under Article 43 of the Constitution. It specifically outlines the modification of ministerial responsibilities by adding the "Boat Ordinance, No. 4 of 1900" to the portfolio of the Minister of Ports and Shipping. This constitutes both the "who" (the President) and the "what" (detailed changes to portfolio responsibilities), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
